tool.name: Download NCBI taxonomy for eDNAFlow LCA
tool.description: install a versioned NCBI ranked-lineage taxonomy snapshot

param.name: name
param.label: Display name
param.help: Optional. By default the snapshot is named NCBI Taxonomy followed by the current date.

tool.help:
Downloads the NCBI expanded taxonomy archive and installs ``rankedlineage.dmp`` for use by the eDNAFlow LCA Galaxy tool.
Each run creates a dated taxonomy snapshot. This allows analyses to record which NCBI taxonomy version was used rather than downloading an unversioned taxonomy during each analysis.
